nonnormal_shear_h24.mechanism: one-day shear forecast amplified by departure from normal modal dynamics

nonnormal_shear_h72.mechanism: three-day shear forecast amplified by non-normal coupling

operator_cumulative_shear_h24.mechanism: one-day cumulative shear forecast from the frozen prior-window propagator

operator_cumulative_shear_h6.mechanism: six-hour cumulative shear forecast of a causal locally linearized spot-perpetual control-volume operator

operator_cumulative_shear_h72.mechanism: three-day cumulative shear forecast from the frozen prior-window propagator

operator_rotation_shear_h24.mechanism: antisymmetric state rotation that transfers source and pressure energy into shear

pressure_impulse_shear_h24.mechanism: one-day pressure and basis impulse transmitted into interlayer shear

slow_mode_shear_h24.equation: dominant stable eigenmode contribution to 24-hour cumulative shear
slow_mode_shear_h24.mechanism: release of the slowest locally stable interlayer mode

slow_mode_shear_h72.equation: dominant stable eigenmode contribution to 72-hour cumulative shear
slow_mode_shear_h72.mechanism: long-memory contribution of the slowest stable mode

slow_mode_source_alignment_h24.mechanism: slow-mode relaxation supported or opposed by current observable sources

slow_mode_source_alignment_h72.mechanism: long slow-mode relaxation aligned with position and funding sources

source_impulse_shear_h24.mechanism: one-day shear response attributable only to position and participation sources

spectral_relaxation_shear_h24.mechanism: forecast shear weighted by the local spectral relaxation rate

transient_growth_direction_h24.mechanism: signed transient energy growth even when all local eigenmodes are stable

transient_growth_direction_h72.mechanism: longer transient growth generated by a non-normal interlayer operator
